_about: Settings for rivals2_move_boxes.py, make_legend.py and run_pipeline.py. Edit freely; no script changes needed.
Anything missing here falls back to the scripts' built-in values, so you can delete entries you don't care about.
Colors are [R, G, B] with 0-255 channels, or "#RRGGBB". Alpha (opacity) is 0 (invisible) to 255 (solid): 50% = 128, 80% = 204, 90% = 230.
After changing colors, run: python make_legend.py   (redraws images/box_legend.png)
Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

_colors.order: Picked by HitResponse first (grab, hitgrab, detect, kill_projectiles), then projectile, tipper, then the sweet/sour name label, else normal.
_colors.sweet: Hit whose hitbox or damage-property name contains "sweet"
_colors.tipper: Hit whose damage properties have a tipper effect (see tipper_effects); light blue like training mode
_colors.projectile: Hit from a projectile article (Zetterburn's fireball, Fleet's arrows...); yellow like training mode
_colors.grab: HitResponse Grab: standard and command grabs
_colors.detect: HitResponse Detect/DetectAll: triggers or sensors, no damage

_notes.colors: One per gameplay state (ERivalsHurtboxState). Disabled = HurtboxActive false, drawn only if show_disabled is true.
_notes.outline_lighten: Outline is the fill tinted toward white: 0 = same as fill, 1 = white.

_tipper_effects: On-hit SpecialEffect values drawn in the tipper color. Training mode colors only Clairen's tipper; add another effect here if training shows it in its own color.

articles._extra_frames: Past a move's end, keep rendering at most this many frames while an article's hitboxes are still appearing or changing (the character holds its last pose). Per-move behavior rules are in article_rules.json.

_info_notes_defaults: info.md's Notes column lists a hit's AdvancedOnHitProperties only when they differ from these usual values (the most common value across the game). Change a value to show or hide that setting.

pipeline._default_skips: Moves run_pipeline.py skips unless --no-default-skips: case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the attack asset name (ATT_Lox_Intro). --skip REGEX adds more for one run.

remote._about: run_remote_render.py renders on this SSH host (key login) in this folder; python creates its venv. jobs null = the remote CPU count minus 1. Flags --host, --remote-dir, --remote-python, --jobs override these.
